# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}

Get a specific workflow by ID (filename)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-281`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| workflow_id | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — ActionWorkflow

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string | workflow filename |
| `name` | string | workflow name from YAML or filename |
| `path` | string | full path in repo |
| `state` | string | active or disabled_manually |
| `url` | string | API URL |
| `html_url` | string | web URL |
| `badge_url` | string | badge SVG URL |
| `created_at` | time.Time | commit author time |
| `updated_at` | time.Time | commit author time |

- **404** — workflow file not found in default branch
- **500** — internal error reading git tree
